title: Migration 0020 strands pre-existing stable-at-zero characters: recovery silently never fires
description:
Post-merge review of PR #457 (verified against current main, 2026-07-19).

## Defect

Characters already `stable` at 0 HP when migration 0020 runs are silently excluded from automatic stable recovery forever, violating the durable-deadline contract (eshyra-2n1t.8.1) for migrated campaigns.

Code facts (all verified):

- `packages/core/data/migrations/0020_stable_recovery_deadline.sql` only adds three nullable columns (`stable_recovery_roll`, `stable_recovery_anchor_elapsed_minutes`, `stable_recovery_deadline_elapsed_minutes`); no backfill for existing stable-at-zero rows.
- `resolveStableRecoveries` (`packages/core/src/state/hpLifecycle.ts:604-613`) requires all three fields `IS NOT NULL` in its WHERE clause, so legacy rows are silently skipped — no error, no evidence.
- There is no repair path: `stabilizeCharacter` (`hpLifecycle.ts:564-568`) throws unless `life_state === 'dying'`, so an already-stable character cannot be re-scheduled.

The only workaround is out-of-band (GM heals the character), which defeats the automatic-recovery feature the migration claims to complete.

## Required fix (per review)

Provide an explicit migration/adoption policy for legacy stable-at-zero rows. Options:

1. Quarantine legacy stable-at-zero rows with repair evidence and fail closed; or
2. Schedule them deterministically in a migration-aware domain step with recorded provenance (note: scheduling needs an RNG roll — if done in a SQL migration it must be deterministic and recorded; a code-level adoption step with provenance is likely cleaner than pure SQL).

Regardless of the option chosen, `resolveStableRecoveries` should throw (fail closed, consistent with the codebase's philosophy) on a stable-at-zero character with missing or *partially* populated schedule fields rather than silently ignoring it. Add tests for: legacy NULL-field stable row surfaced/adopted rather than skipped, and partial-field corruption raising an error.

Migration checksums are immutable — do not edit 0020; use a new migration.

Related (same PR #457 review): Demon Armor permanent doff block, advanceWorldTime recovery atomicity, rest benefits evidence gap.
notes:
Sibling beads from PR #457 post-merge review: eshyra-gacz (Demon Armor doff), eshyra-r2ps (clock/recovery atomicity), eshyra-cc3c (rest evidence gap). Reviewer recommends one follow-up PR; the first three are re-freeze blockers.
Fix merged to branch eshyra-geny; PR #459 open (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/459). Close after PR merge.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #459 (merge commit 846a52f5), including review-round hardening: migration partial-schedule guard and canonical conditions validation.
